_howToAddAProject: Add an entry under projects: gitRemote (GitLab path that identifies the checkout), repoDirName (usual folder name), tolgee {apiUrl, projectId or null, apiKeyEnv, languageTags}, files {dir, format: i18next|easy_localization|icu, fileTags}, codeGlobs, writeRule.
